description: Advisory alignment and viewport safety patterns, not hard universal aesthetics or verified site snapshots.

references.name: IBM Carbon Grid
references.lesson: Use aligned columns, rows and gutters for product layouts

references.name: MDN minmax
references.lesson: Control grid track minimum sizing to avoid intrinsic blowout

references.name: web.dev viewport sizing
references.lesson: Use viewport-relative units carefully with dynamic UI chrome

references.name: MDN viewport concepts
references.lesson: Check layout vs visual viewport when keyboards or zoom affect position

patterns.label: Shared-row grid
patterns.requires: grid areas or common row wrapper; explicit reading order
patterns.exception: varying heights allowed; same physical height not universally required

patterns.label: Full-width primary content and secondary split
patterns.requires: one major row with full-span chart plus compact secondary data row
patterns.exception: content hierarchy must justify the feature span

patterns.label: Editorial deliberate asymmetry
patterns.requires: documented hierarchy and alignment anchors, not arbitrary column drift
patterns.exception: visual narrative is intentionally more important than data comparison

patterns.label: Masonry gallery
patterns.requires: independent-height visual items with no row comparison
patterns.exception: not default for data cards or release metrics

scroll_modes.end_guard: padding after last meaningful content + safe area

scroll_modes.layout: height:100dvh; grid rows auto minmax(0,1fr); main min-height:0; overflow-y:auto
scroll_modes.end_guard: padding in actual scroll container + safe area

scroll_modes.layout: fixed actions can overlap main content
scroll_modes.end_guard: reserve measured fixed bar height + safe area or use normal-flow layout
